name: Lugenau
beschreibung: In the entry, Campingplatz Lugenau is described as a site in a natural location in a valley of Tirol, surrounded by a mountain panorama. The atmosphere is considered quiet and close to nature. The facilities listed include sanitary facilities, electrical connections and a shop; according to the entry, guests can start cycling and hiking tours directly from the site. In the surrounding area, a network of hiking trails is available in summer and connections to several ski resorts in winter. According to the entry, the site serves as a base for excursions into nature. A clear assignment to a specific place in Tirol was not possible based on the information provided and the stored coordinates, as these refer to a site of the same name in Upper Bavaria. For this reason, no further unverified business details are provided.
